subject: ✅ RSVP Confirmed — $event_name ($rsvp_status_display)
body:
Dear $recipient_name,

This confirms your RSVP. You can change your response at any time via the Events portal — just please give us a heads-up before catering numbers are locked in.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
RSVP SUMMARY
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Event:           $event_name
Date:            $event_date
Time:            $start_time – $end_time
Location:        $location
Your RSVP:       $rsvp_status_display
Guests:          $num_guests
RSVP Recorded:   $rsvp_recorded_on
Event ID:        $event_id

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

WHAT NOW

$status_specific_message

If this RSVP is wrong, you can change or withdraw it through the Events portal before the deadline. After the deadline, contact the host directly — they may be able to absorb last-minute changes if catering allows.

Thanks for letting us know — see you there!

Kind regards,
University Events Team
